title: Brown University shooting: person of interest in custody is in his 20s, police chief confirms – as it happened
summary: This live blog is now closed. You can read our latest reporting here: Person of interest detained in Brown University shooting that left two dead What we know so far Brown University students were told that all remaining classes and exams for the semester would be delayed after the shooting that killed two people and left several others injured. In a note to students, the university’s provost, Francis J Doyle III , said the decision was made “out of our profound concern for all students, faculty and staff on our campus”. He encouraged students and staff to focus on their safety and wellbeing. In the immediate aftermath of these devastating events, we recognize that learning and assessment are significantly hindered in the short term and that many students and others will wish to depart campus. Students are free to leave if they are able. Students who remain will have access to on-campus services and support. At this time, it is essential that we focus our efforts on providing care and support to the members of our community as we grapple with the sorrow, fear and anxiety that is impacting all of us right now. University leaders are committed to providing care and mobilizing resources to assist our community members through this difficult time. Continue reading...

title: Zelenskiy Hints US Guarantees May Stand in Place of NATO Bid
summary: President Volodymyr Zelenskiy signaled that Ukraine could accept security guarantees from the US and Europe as a way to prevent future Russian aggression, and substitute for its long-term goal of joining NATO.
